meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先分析你的需求，推断出合适的设计方向，然后生成不套模板的前端界面。它使用真实的设计系统，避免常见的AI设计套路。
howto.when: 当你要求它创建落地页、作品集或进行网站改版时触发。它会先读取你的需求，然后输出设计方向并生成代码。

say.text: 帮我做一个B2B SaaS落地页，风格像Linear那样简洁。
say.note: Claude会分析需求，输出设计方向并生成代码。

say.text: 给我的设计师作品集重新设计，要更有实验性。
say.note: Claude会先审计现有设计，然后进行改版。

say.text: 做一个面向技术买家的落地页，使用Tailwind和Geist字体。
say.note: Claude会根据需求选择合适的设计系统和工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze your brief, infer the right design direction, and ship interfaces that don't look templated. It uses real design systems and avoids common AI defaults.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for landing pages, portfolios, or redesigns. It reads the brief first, then outputs a design direction and generates code.

say_en.text: Build a B2B SaaS landing page with a clean Linear-style look.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the brief, output a design read, and generate code.

say_en.text: Redesign my designer portfolio to be more experimental.
say_en.note: Claude will audit the existing design first, then overhaul it.

say_en.text: Create a landing page for technical buyers using Tailwind and Geist.
say_en.note: Claude will pick the right design system and tools based on the brief.
